name: No significant harm screen (DNSH-equivalent)

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.32-4.38 — Sustainability Impact products must not cause significant harm to other sustainability objectives in pursuit of their impact objective)

summary: Tests whether the asset clears a DNSH-equivalent screen — pursuing the impact objective must not cause significant harm to other environmental or social objectives. PS23/16 ¶4.38 imposes this screen but does not specify methodology; PB methodology v3.5 satisfies it by reading the upstream EU Taxonomy 8.1 DNSH result via cross-framework dependency. If EU Taxonomy 8.1 DNSH is aligned, this criterion is aligned. If any DNSH criterion fails, this criterion fails. This mirrors the SFDR Article 9 c4 cross-framework DNSH pattern, applied to UK SDR Impact.
